description: Record a capability test as run (write — editor). Each finding becomes a deficiency. passed needs no findings; passed_with_findings or failed need at least one (422).

findings.description: Findings (up to 100); each is recorded as a deficiency linked to the test

owner_user_id.description: Owner user — must be a member of the organisation (404 otherwise); see scf_list_members

priority.description: Priority: critical, high, medium, low (platform default medium)

risk_code.description: Risk the finding is against, if any — must be assessed

scf_id.description: Control the finding is against, if any — must be in scope (422 otherwise)

title.description: Short title of the finding (1–255 chars, non-blank)

outcome.description: What happened, and what was learned (non-blank)

result.description: Result: passed, passed_with_findings, failed. passed means no findings; the others need at least one

test_type.description: Kind of test: incident_response, continuity, other

tested_on.description: Day the test was run (YYYY-MM-DD); not in the future (422)

name: scf_create_capability_test
